pages.text: Sacks of olives piled at one side of the field. They needed carrying to the house uphill.
Lulu held the little cart handle. "I will pull this cart."
Uncle Beppo pointed his walking stick at the tall grass. "In our day, we took that shortcut. Follow me."
He led into the grass. Lulu pulled the cart behind him.
The grass grew as tall as Lulu. It wound tightly round the wheels.
Clunk! The cart stopped. Push or pull, it would not move.
Uncle Beppo tilted his head. "Strange. There used to be a path here."
Lulu turned the cart around. "I will take our usual main road." The walking stick went on the cart.
Uphill, Lulu pulled, and Uncle Beppo pushed. Rattle, rattle! The cart climbed steadily.
They reached the yard. The walking stick rode atop the olive sacks. "The stick had the easiest trip!" Lulu laughed.
